end.summary:
Predicted that objects with curved surfaces roll in 4 unaided attempts.
Discussed a tin and bottle rolling when their curved sides touch the floor.
Identified that a flat book slides when on its side.
Explained “side” as the bottle lying with its rounded part touching the floor.
Teach-back was not passed; lesson ended when Anika asked to stop.
end.parentNote: Asha practised sorting objects by whether they roll or slide, using real-life examples and asking Anika to explain her predictions. Anika first thought only a ball might roll, but later corrected this for the tin and bottle by noticing their curved surfaces. At home, invite them to predict whether safe objects will roll or slide, then test them on the floor with supervision.
